description: Verify Japanese companies against official registries with JPVerify: identify a Japanese company from an English or romanized name, postal code, T-number, LEI or securities code with English output; corporate number (法人番号) lookup by number or company name, active/closed status, registered address, a company pre-check report with risk flags, company profile (capital, employees, website), listing, EDINET filings, Financial Services Agency licences and former names. Use when a task involves confirming that a Japanese company exists, finding its corporate number, or doing a pre-check before onboarding or paying a Japanese counterparty. Paid per call (API key credits or x402).
